Discovery now includes decision models and improved reliability on slower servers.

## What's New

- Adds support for decision models.

## Bug Fixes

- Improves model discovery reliability by increasing timeouts to 15 seconds.

---

### What's Changed

- feat: support decision models, [`df5e24e`](https://github.com/florianilch/opencode-llamacpp-provider/commit/df5e24e92f0a44dc0c81e5b0ccc995bd91abf242) ([#1](https://github.com/florianilch/opencode-llamacpp-provider/pull/1))
- test: cover model discovery behavior, [`4547734`](https://github.com/florianilch/opencode-llamacpp-provider/commit/45477348e6185ff87b0f9b733b923ce5b1009a84)
- style: code format, [`2a0470a`](https://github.com/florianilch/opencode-llamacpp-provider/commit/2a0470ae66f23eddb442d88de51bed55432139fd)
- fix: allow more time for llama.cpp model discovery, [`77667be`](https://github.com/florianilch/opencode-llamacpp-provider/commit/77667be975ede423b341dbe26f3c0d738c0d5a33)
